verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              कथं बहुयुगे काले समतीते द्विजोत्तम। न जरा रेवतीं प्राप्ता रैवतं च ककुद्मिनम्॥१॥
मेरुं गतस्य वा तस्य शर्यातेः सन्ततिः कथम्। स्थिता पृथिव्यामद्यापि श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥२॥
verses.english: "Oh, brahmana, you said many eras have lapsed when रैवत returned from brahma's abode along with lady रेवति ... how is that रैवत-ककुद्मि is not scourged by old age in that much of time... when raivata of sharyAti dynasty cut off earthly connections and went away to Mt. meru for ascesis, how is that kings of his dynasty alone is ruling the earth even today... what has happened to his brothers and nephews... all this I would like to listen in its factuality...
verses.bhavadeepa: शर्यातेरन्वयाख्यानं पूर्वं धुन्धुकमारणम्। उक्तमेकादशे विष्णोरुत्तङ्कस्य प्रसादजम्॥१॥ कथमिति। जन्मवतः परिणामावश्यम्भावात्कथं तयोर्जराया अप्राप्तिरिति प्रश्नः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              न जरा क्षुत्पिपासे वा न मृत्युर्भरतर्षभ। ऋतुचक्रं न भवति ब्रह्मलोके सदानघ॥३॥
verses.english: Accordingly kuvalAshva journeyed along with his hundred sons, led by sage uttanka, on the mission elimination-demon-dundhu.

verses.sanskrit: ककुद्मिनस्तु तं लोकं रैवतस्य गतस्य ह। हता पुण्यजनैस्तात राक्षसैः सा कुशस्थली॥४॥
verses.english: When raivata-kakudmi went to the abode of brahma, rAkshasA-s and पुण्य-जना-s, i.e., yakshA-s, have devastated his capital कुश-स्थलि together with his hundred brothers... while rAkshasA-s are devastating thus, some of his kith and kin have fled in all directions seeking safe haven here and there... those fugitive kshatriya-s lived here and there, even making the mountain-caves as their hideaway, to lie low in the scare of rAkshasA-s... but wherever they are, their progeny increased there, and thus they all came to be known as the legatees of sharyAti...
verses.bhavadeepa: उत्तरमाह- न जरेति। जठराग्निप्रभावेण क्षुधादयो भवन्ति। तत्पाचितान्नेन परिणामान्तरं जायते। पूर्वपरिणामश्च नश्यति। ततो जरा प्रवर्तते। अग्नेश्च प्रवर्तकः कालः सूर्यादिनिर्वर्त्यः ब्रह्मलोके तु सूर्याद्यभावान्न तन्मूलकाः कालाग्निक्षुज्जरा इत्यर्थः॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भ्रातृशतं चासीद्धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः। तद्वध्यमानं रक्षोभिर्दिशः प्राद्रवदच्युतम्॥५॥
verses.english: The son of नाभग and the son of अरिष्ट, both being vaishya-s have turned up as brAhmaNa-s, and the sons of कारूष have emerged as kshatriya heroes indomitable in battlefields...

verses.sanskrit: विद्रुतस्य तु राजेन्द्र तस्य भ्रातृशतस्य वै। तेषां तु ते भयाक्रान्ताः क्षत्रियास्तत्र तत्र ह॥६॥
verses.english: The son of नाभग and the son of अरिष्ट, both being vaishya-s have turned up as brAhmaNa-s, and the sons of कारूष have emerged as kshatriya heroes indomitable in battlefields...

verses.sanskrit: अन्ववायस्तु सुमहांस्तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते। येषामेते महाराज शर्याता इति विश्रुताः॥७॥
verses.english: "Oh, godly sage, I have laid down arms... but, here is my son kuvalAshva who is capable of eradicating that demon's menace... no doubt about it..." so said bR^ihadashva to sage uttanka.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रिया भरतश्रेष्ठ दिक्षु सर्वासु धार्मिकाः। सर्वशः पर्वतगणान्प्रविष्टाः कुरुननदन॥८॥
verses.english: When raivata-kakudmi went to the abode of brahma, rAkshasA-s and पुण्य-जना-s, i.e., yakshA-s, have devastated his capital कुश-स्थलि together with his hundred brothers... while rAkshasA-s are devastating thus, some of his kith and kin have fled in all directions seeking safe haven here and there... those fugitive kshatriya-s lived here and there, even making the mountain-caves as their hideaway, to lie low in the scare of rAkshasA-s... but wherever they are, their progeny increased there, and thus they all came to be known as the legatees of sharyAti...

verses.sanskrit: नाभागारिष्टपुत्रौ द्वौ वैश्यौ ब्राह्मणतां गतौ। करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः॥९॥
verses.english: Rest of the forty-eight princess together with their father शशाद, a nick name for विकुक्शि, have been safeguarding southern provinces...

verses.sanskrit: प्रांशोरेकोऽभवत्पुत्रः प्रजातिरिति नः श्रुतम्। पृषध्रो हिंसयित्वा तु गुरोर्गां जनमेजय॥१०॥
verses.english: This earth remains imperturbable if only protected by a great soul like you... hence it is inapt of you to proceed to forests...

verses.sanskrit: शापाच्छूद्रत्वमापन्नो नवैते परिकीर्तिताः। वैवस्वतस्य तनया मनोर्वै भरतर्षभ॥११॥
verses.english: Accordingly vikukshi went on a hunting game, but firstly he felled a rabbit, barbecued, and ate it... thus, when he is on the errand to fetch paraphernalia of the ritual, he utilised some for his own sake... later he felled some more animals and brought meat for the ritual of manes, whereby the meat he brought has become defiled, because he fetched the offertory after satiating his own stomach... thus he has acquired a nickname शशाद...

verses.sanskrit: क्षुवतश्च मनोस्तात इक्ष्वाकुरभवत्सुतः। तस्य पुत्रशतं त्वासीदिक्ष्वाकोर्भूरिदक्षिणम्॥१२॥
verses.english: But, sage vasiShTha noticing that vikukshi brought an unbefitting food for manes, reported the same to king ikshvAku, and king ikshvAku rusticated vikukshi from the capital for this insolent act, whereby शशाद , alias vikukshi, had to re-enter the capital only after the demise of his father ikshvAku... whereupon vikukshi became the king of ayodhya...

verses.sanskrit: तेषां विकुक्षिर्ज्येष्ठस्तु विकुक्षित्वादयोधताम्। प्राप्तः परमधर्मज्ञः सोऽयोध्याधिपतिः प्रभुः॥१३॥
verses.english: The son of shashAda, alias vikukshi, is the highly valiant ककुत्स्थ... we hear that kakutstha strode on the hump of a bull in certain conflict of gods and demons, where that bull is none other than indra in disguise of a bull, and thus he acquired appellation of kakutstha...

verses.sanskrit: शकुनिप्रमुखास्तस्य पुत्राः पञ्चाशदुत्तमाः। उत्तरापथदेशस्था रक्षितारो महीपते॥१४॥
verses.english: ककुत्स्थ got अनेन as his son; from him forward the lineal descent of princess is like this : अनेन → पृथु → विष्टर-अश्व→ आर्द्र → युवनाश्व → श्राव,orश्रास्तक।This श्रावस्त is the builder ofश्रावस्तिcity, which is why it is named after him. And बृहदश्वis the son of shrAsta॥।

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशदथाष्टौ च दक्षिणस्यां तथा दिशि। शशादप्रमुखाश्चान्ये रक्षितारो विशाम्पते॥१५॥
verses.english: Please see that this giant is eliminated for the welfare of world... the moment he is eliminated people will feel secure...

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुस्तु विकुक्षिर्वै अष्टकायामथादिशत्। मांसमानय श्राद्धार्थं मृगान्हत्वा महाबल॥१६॥
verses.english: Once king ikshvAku has ordered his son vikukshi to fetch meat by hunting animals for a ritual towards manes called अSटक श्राद्धम्...

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धकर्मणि चोद्दिष्ट अकृते श्राद्धकर्मणि। भक्षयित्वा शशं तात शशादो मृगयां गतः॥१७॥
verses.english: Accordingly vikukshi went on a hunting game, but firstly he felled a rabbit, barbecued, and ate it... thus, when he is on the errand to fetch paraphernalia of the ritual, he utilised some for his own sake... later he felled some more animals and brought meat for the ritual of manes, whereby the meat he brought has become defiled, because he fetched the offertory after satiating his own stomach... thus he has acquired a nickname शशाद...

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुणा परित्यक्तो वसिष्ठवचनात् प्रभुः। इक्ष्वाकौ संस्थिते तात शशादः पुरमावसत्॥१८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: श्राद्धेति। एतेन यदर्थं यदुद्दिष्टं तस्मै तददत्वाऽन्यत्र विनियुज्यते चेद्दोषाय भवतीति दर्शितम्। मृगयां गतः मृगयात आगत एव इक्ष्वाकुणा परित्यक्त इत्युत्तरेणान्वयः॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: शशादस्य तु दायादः ककुत्स्थो नाम वीर्यवान्। इन्द्रस्य वृषभूतस्य ककुत्स्थोऽजयतासुरान्॥१९॥
verses.english: When that noble souled great sage uttanka said in this way, then king bR^ihadashva presented his son kuvalAshva to that sage, for the mission of elimination-demon-dundhu.
verses.bhavadeepa: वसिष्ठवचनात् हविरिदमुच्छिष्टं न पितृयोग्यमित्येवंरूपात् संस्थिते मृते॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं देवासुरे युद्धे ककुत्स्थस्तेन हि स्मृतः। अनेनास्तु ककुत्स्थस्य पृथुरानेनसः स्मृतः॥२०॥
verses.english: It is evident that governing people well is dharma... as such let your mind uninclined towards forests... nowhere we see this kind of deflection from one's own dharma... sagely kings, say your ancestors, have always been protecting people... a king has to protect people, hence it will be apt of you to protect people...

verses.sanskrit: विष्टराश्वः पृथोः पुत्रस्तस्मादार्द्रस्त्वजायत। आर्द्रस्य युवनाश्वस्तु श्रावस्तस्य तु चात्मजः॥२१॥
verses.english: Near at my hermitage, there is a place on even land which at places is devoid of water - मरुSउ, मरु भूमि वत्, like a crematorium; and at some places with skimpy water - धन्वसु, अल्प उदकेSउ; but surrounded by ocean and dunes, and which is a well noted place for depopulation...

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे श्रावस्तको राजा श्रावस्ती येन निर्मिता। श्रावस्तस्य तु दायादो बृहदश्वो महयशाः॥२२॥
verses.english: ककुत्स्थ got अनेन as his son; from him forward the lineal descent of princess is like this : अनेन → पृथु → विष्टर-अश्व→ आर्द्र → युवनाश्व → श्राव,orश्रास्तक।This श्रावस्त is the builder ofश्रावस्तिcity, which is why it is named after him. And बृहदश्वis the son of shrAsta॥।

verses.sanskrit: कुवलाश्वः सुतस्तस्य राजा परमधार्मिकः। यः स धुन्धुवधाद्राजा धुन्धुमारत्वमागतः॥२३॥
verses.english: "Oh, brahman, I would like to listen vividly about the elimination of demon dundhu... what for कुवलाश्व has got the title of 'the eliminator of dundhu...'

verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              धुन्धोर्वधमहं ब्रह्मञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। यदर्थं कुवलाश्वः सन्धुन्धुमारत्वमागतः॥२४॥
verses.english: Please see that this giant is eliminated for the welfare of world... the moment he is eliminated people will feel secure...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              कुवलाश्वस्य पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम्। सर्वे विद्यासु निष्णाता बलवन्तो दुरासदाः॥२५॥
बभूवुर्धार्मिकाः सर्वे यज्वानो भूरिदक्षिणाः। कुवलाश्वं सुतं राज्ये बृहदश्वो न्ययोजयत्॥२६॥
verses.english: कुवलाश्व begot hundred sons... and when those princes have become great archers, experts in scriptures, mighty, unassailable, righteous, and true ritualists and lavish donors, then kuvalAshva's father बृहदश्व enthroned कुवलाश्व in ayodhya... thus, when his son कुवलाश्व derived the glory of ayodhya kingdom, बृहदश्व set forth for woods to undertake ascesis... but when he set out, a sage of higher order, namely sage उत्तन्क, approached बृहदश्व and said to him...

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रसङ्क्रामितश्रीस्तु वनं राजा समाविशत्। तमुत्तङ्कोऽथ विप्रर्षिः प्रयान्तं प्रत्यवारयत्॥२७॥
verses.english: When that noble souled great sage uttanka said in this way, then king bR^ihadashva presented his son kuvalAshva to that sage, for the mission of elimination-demon-dundhu.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्तङ्क उवाच।
              भवता रक्षणं कार्यं तत्तावत्कर्तुमर्हसि। निरुद्विग्नस्तपश्चर्तुं न हि शक्नोषि पार्थिव॥२८॥
verses.english: "Oh, godly sage, I have laid down arms... but, here is my son kuvalAshva who is capable of eradicating that demon's menace... no doubt about it..." so said bR^ihadashva to sage uttanka.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया हि पृथिवी राजन्रक्ष्यमाणा महात्मना। भविष्यति निरुद्विग्ना नारण्यं गन्तुमर्हसि॥२९॥
पालने हि महान्धर्मः प्रजानामिह दृश्यते। न तथा दृश्यतेऽरण्ये मा तेऽभूद्बुद्धिरीदृशी॥३०॥
verses.english: Accordingly kuvalAshva journeyed along with his hundred sons, led by sage uttanka, on the mission elimination-demon-dundhu.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशो न हि राजेन्द्र धर्मः क्वचन दृश्यते। प्रजानां पालने यो वै पुरा राजर्षिभिः कृतः। रक्षितव्याः प्रजा राज्ञा तास्त्वं रक्षितुमर्हसि॥३१॥
verses.english: Then the resplendence of god viShNu embraced kuvalAshva, as has been directed by sage uttanka, and for the welfare of worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ममाश्रमसमीपे हि समेषु मरुधन्वसु। समुद्रो वालुकापूर्ण उज्जानक इति श्रुतः। देवतानामवध्यश्च महाकायो महाबलः॥३२॥
verses.english: When that unassailable king kuvalAshva set out, then there is a great voice-over in skies which said, 'this glorious man is inextirpable, thus, he becomes the eliminator of dundhu now... ' and saying so, the gods have strewn divine fragrances through divine flowers around him, and they even blared divine drums of triumph.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्भूमिगतस्तत्र वालुकान्तर्हितो महान्। राक्षसस्य मधोः पुत्रो धुन्धुनामा महासुरः। शेते लोकविनाशाय तप आस्थाय दारुणम्॥३३॥
verses.english: Having proceeded to demon's place along with his hundred sons that best conqueror started digging the ocean together with expansive sand-dunes, to locate the demon hiding under dunes. He acquired this much force owing to the presence of the force of nArAyaNa, which entered him just now, only to reinforce his dynamism.
verses.bhavadeepa: समेषु पर्वताद्यभावान्निम्नोन्नतवर्जितेषु मरुषु निर्जलेषु धन्वसु अल्पोदकेषु उज्जानकः जनस्य समूहो जानकं तद्रहित उज्जानकः। उज्जालकेति पाठे जलसमूहवर्जितः॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरस्य पर्यन्ते स निश्वासं प्रमुञ्चति। यदा तदा भूश्चलति सशैलवनकानना॥३४॥
verses.english: And on ordering his son kuvalAshva to eliminate demon dundhu, that kingly sage bR^ihadashva went to mountains to undertake his vow of ascesis.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य निःश्वासवातेन रज उद्धूयते महत्। आदित्यपथमावृत्य सप्ताहं भूमिकम्पनम्॥३५॥
verses.english: That demon has burnt down all the sons of the king, excepting for three. Even then, that king's pursuit has not ceased. He chased the demon with a war-whoop, "dhuM... dhuM..." As with an exalted yogi swallowing wildfire, this king too drank the impetuous water of the ocean only to locate the demon. Having located that oceanic-water-demon, kuvalAshva has eliminated that mighty demon, and proved his mettle to sage uttanka.

verses.sanskrit: सविस्फुलिङ्गं साङ्गारं सधूममतिदारुणम्। तेन तात न शक्नोमि तस्मिन्स्थातुं स्वकाश्रमे॥३६॥
verses.english: When kuvalAshva has shown his fortitude to sage uttanka, that sage gave him boons for an undiminished wealth, invincibility, involvement in dharma, and an unmitigated dwelling in heaven. That sage uttanka has further blessed the ninety-seven sons of the king who fell dead owing demonic effect to have an unlessened stay in heavens.

verses.sanskrit: तं मारय महाकायं लोकानां हितकाम्यया। लोकाः स्वस्था भवन्त्यद्य तस्मिन्विनिहतेऽसुरे॥३७॥
त्वं हि तस्य वधायैकः समर्थः पृथिवीपते। विष्णुना च वरो दत्तो मह्यं पूर्वयुगेऽनघ॥३८॥
यस्त्वं महासुरं रौद्रं हनिष्यसि महाबलम्। तस्य त्वं वरदानेन तेज आप्याययिष्यसि॥३९॥
न हि धुन्धुर्महातेजास्तेजसाल्पेन शक्यते। निर्दग्धुं पृथिवीपाल स हि वर्षशतैरपि। वीर्यं हि सुमहत्तस्य देवैरपि दुरासदम्॥४०॥
verses.english: None with meagre capacity can eliminate that highly powerful demon dundhu, even in hundreds of years to come... that demon's might is so great even gods cannot assail him..." so said sage uttanka to king bR^ihadashva...

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो राजर्षिरुत्तङ्केन महात्मना। कुवलाश्वं सुतं प्रादात्तस्मै धुन्धुनिवारणे॥४१॥

बृहदश्व उवाच।
              भगवन्न्यस्तशस्त्रोऽहमयं तु तनयो मम। भविष्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ धुन्धुमारो न संशयः॥४२॥
स तं व्यादिश्य तनयं राजर्षिर्धुन्धुमारणे। जगाम पर्वतायैव तपसे संशितव्रतः॥४३॥

वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              कुवलाश्वस्तु पुत्राणां शतेन सह पार्थिवः। प्रायादुत्तङ्कसहितो धुन्धोस्तस्य विनिग्रहे॥४४॥
तमाविशत्तदा विष्णुर्भगवांस्तेजसा प्रभुः। उत्तङ्कस्य नियोगाद्वै लोकास्य हितकाम्यया॥४५॥
तस्मिन्प्रयाते दुर्धर्षे दिवि शब्दो महानभूत्। एष श्रीमानवध्योऽद्य धुन्धुमारो भविष्यति॥४६॥
दिव्यैर्माल्यैश्च तं देवाः समन्तात्समवाकिरन्। देवदुन्दुभयश्चापि प्रणेदुर्भरतर्षभ॥४७॥
स गत्वा जयतां श्रेष्ठस्तनयैः सह वीर्यवान्। समुद्रं खानयामास वालुकार्णवमव्ययम्॥४८॥
नारायणेन कौरव्य तेजसाऽऽप्यायितः स वै। बभूव स महातेजाः भूयो बलसमन्वितः॥४९॥
तस्य पुत्रैः खनद्भिस्तु वालुकान्तर्हितस्तदा। धुन्धुरासादितो राजन्दिशमावृत्य पश्चिमाम्॥५०॥
मुखजेनाग्निना क्रोधाल्लोकानुद्वर्तयन्निव। वारि सुस्राव वेगेन महोदधिरिवोदये॥५१॥
सोमस्य भरतश्रेष्ठ धारोर्मिकलिलं महत्। तस्य पुत्रशतं दग्धं त्रिभिरूनं तु रक्षसा॥५२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: मुखजेनाग्निना तस्य पुत्रशतं दग्धमित्युत्तरेण सम्बन्धः। स च वारि सुस्त्राव स्वदेहजलेन भुवमाप्लावितवानित्यर्थः॥५१॥

verses.sanskrit: ततः स राजा कौरव्य राक्षसं तं महाबलम्। आससाद महातेजा धुन्धुं धुन्धुनिबर्हणः॥५३॥
verses.english: That demon has burnt down all the sons of the king, excepting for three. Even then, that king's pursuit has not ceased. He chased the demon with a war-whoop, "dhuM... dhuM..." As with an exalted yogi swallowing wildfire, this king too drank the impetuous water of the ocean only to locate the demon. Having located that oceanic-water-demon, kuvalAshva has eliminated that mighty demon, and proved his mettle to sage uttanka.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वारिमयं वेगमापीय स नराधिपः। योगी योगेन वह्निं च शमयामास वारिणा॥५४॥
निहत्य तं महाकायं बलेनोदकराक्षसम्। उत्तङ्कं दर्शयामास कृतकर्मा नराधिपः॥५५॥
उत्तङ्कस्तु वरं प्रादात्तस्मै राज्ञे महात्मने। ददौ तस्याक्षयं वित्तं शत्रुभिश्चापराजयम्॥५६॥
धर्मे रतिं च सततं स्वर्गवासं तथाक्षयम्। पुत्राणां चाक्षयाँल्लोकान्स्वर्गे ये रक्षसा हताः॥५७॥
